summary: Initial release of PlainHealth — health education in plain language with lab results, medications, conditions, Q&A, health tools, and premium content.
included: 24 lab tests with plain-language explanations across 10 categories (Blood Count, Metabolic, Lipids, Thyroid, Liver, Kidney, Diabetes, Vitamins, Inflammation, Heart)
24 medications with uses, side effects, food interactions, and warnings across 12 categories
22 health conditions with symptoms, causes, prevention, and doctor questions across 14 categories
Ask (Q&A chat) with keyword-matching engine and 20+ health topic responses
50+ medical glossary terms with plain-language definitions
Health Numbers quick reference with color-coded ranges (BP, cholesterol, blood sugar, BMI, thyroid, kidney, heart rate, temperature)
Emergency guide with heart attack, stroke FAST protocol, anaphylaxis, and crisis resources
First aid guide with 10 comprehensive topics and step-by-step instructions
Pre-visit prep for 8 doctor visit types with tailored questions
Health calculators: BMI, heart rate zones, water intake, calorie calculator
Health tracker for 8 metrics with local history
My Medications personal list tracker
Medication interaction checker with 15+ offline drug interactions
Symptom guide with body system categories and relevance scoring
Family health history tracker
Wellness guides: nutrition, sleep, exercise, mental health, aging, vaccination, hydration
Vital signs reference with normal ranges
Premium content with one-time in-app purchase ($4.99)
StoreKit 2 (iOS) and Google Play Billing (Android) integration
Settings/More tab with premium, privacy policy, about, and developer tools
100% offline — no data collection, no tracking, no accounts required
5-page onboarding with swipeable carousel
Bookmarks/favorites system across all content
Medical disclaimers on every screen
